license.caveats: Not legal advice. UFGS sections reference third-party standards that may carry their own terms; those references are not downloaded or redistributed here. The WBDG site terms page is a single-page application and was not machine-verifiable at retrieval time.

notes: The six documents are specification sections, not a project archive. They do not contain the Chinese completion/acceptance forms required by rules/construction-doc-check.yaml.

No public corpus was found that is both clearly reusable and semantically equivalent to the Chinese rule pack's required document types. The bench therefore does not score the Chinese missing-form rules.
The PDFs are downloaded into .data/ (gitignored) and copied byte-for-byte by adapter.mjs. Their upstream filenames are preserved.
